summary: Refund Eligibility decides whether a refund request is in policy from a sealed charge receipt, a refund request, and a policy, and emits only a gated refund proposal when every evidence gate passes.

observations.claim: The supported CLI used for verification is runx-cli 0.6.13.
observations.evidence: runx --version returned runx-cli 0.6.13, and the harness, publish, install, dogfood, and verify commands were run with that binary.

observations.claim: The package owner is the GitHub and registry publisher zdfgu113.
observations.evidence: The PR branch is hosted in zdfgu113/runx and registry-read.json lists publisher.handle zdfgu113.

observations.claim: The package name is refund-eligibility and the source version is 0.1.0.
observations.evidence: SKILL.md declares name refund-eligibility and version 0.1.0; X.yaml declares skill refund-eligibility and version 0.1.0.
registry-read.json resolved zdfgu113/refund-eligibility@sha-578a29edc86a from https://api.runx.ai with digest 83911644078323687d61301ae4ded68ecad5fe0d608aeff8cc4a1455ca90c46e.

observations.claim: The local harness passed all cases.
observations.evidence: references/harness.json records status passed, case_count 3, and zero assertion errors.

observations.claim: The installed registry package harness passed all cases.
observations.evidence: references/hosted-harness.json records status passed, case_count 3, and zero assertion errors after a clean registry install.

observations.claim: The eligible case emits decision.eligible true and a bounded refund_proposal.
observations.evidence: The in-policy-partial-refund-yields-proposal harness case passed, and published-dogfood.json records decision.reason in_policy with proposal amount 3000 USD.

observations.claim: The proposal records the refundable amount and idempotency key.
observations.evidence: published-dogfood.json records remaining_refundable 5200, requested_amount 3000, and idempotency_key refund:72a56c6bcfd9319fc3ffab7f.

observations.claim: The excessive refund case is refused with no proposal.
observations.evidence: The excessive-amount-is-refused harness case passed with status failure; run.mjs emits decision.reason amount_exceeds_remaining_refundable and exits without refund_proposal for that path.

observations.claim: The unsealed charge case escalates instead of inventing charge evidence.
observations.evidence: The unsealed-charge-escalates harness case passed with status failure; run.mjs maps missing sealed_state evidence to the human_refund_approval lane.

observations.claim: The dogfood run used a post-publish registry package, not only local source.
observations.evidence: published-dogfood.json records registry_provenance.skill_id zdfgu113/refund-eligibility and registry_provenance.version sha-578a29edc86a.

observations.claim: The dogfood receipt is cryptographically valid.
observations.evidence: published-verification.json records valid true, production signature mode, one receipt in the tree, and no findings.

observations.claim: The public PR contains the submitted skill package and evidence.
observations.evidence: PR https://github.com/runxhq/runx/pull/124 contains skills/refund-eligibility/X.yaml, SKILL.md, fixtures, and references.

observations.claim: A new user can install, run, and verify the skill without private context.
observations.evidence: install.json records runx add zdfgu113/refund-eligibility@sha-578a29edc86a --registry https://api.runx.ai succeeded, and report.md lists the run and verify commands.
